SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.ORG: 63rd Annual Rio Grande Valley Regional Science & Engineering Fair
SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.DESC: I was part of a three (3) judge team and I evaluated secondary students’ research via the fair criteria.
SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.ACCOMPLISH: Students who placed in first (1st) and second (2nd) place move to the international competition for the fair.

SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.DESC: I was responsible to attend a training session on Blackboard Advance and complete tasks assigned by the Center for Online Learning & Teaching Technology (COLTT) to get certified in Blackboard Advance.
SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.ACCOMPLISH: The purpose of Blackboard Advance training was to get familiar with the blackboard environment and grading element of blackboard. This was also done to help faculty prepare for online courses.
